name: Pearcleaner
tagline: Uninstall your Mac apps and review the leftover files they leave behind.
description:
Pearcleaner is a free, source-available Mac app cleaner that finds an application and its associated files before uninstalling it. Instead of moving only the app bundle to the Trash, it can search for related preferences, support files, caches, and launch items so the removal can be reviewed as one operation.

Drag an app into Pearcleaner or use its Finder extension, inspect the proposed related files, and decide what should actually be deleted. It also includes broader maintenance and software-management features, but its core use is a transparent, review-first uninstall workflow.

## Features

- Uninstall Mac apps and review associated files before removal.
- Search for orphaned files and use configurable include, exclude, and search-sensitivity settings.
- Use a Finder extension, drag and drop, CLI support, and deep links for uninstall workflows.
- Manage or inspect Homebrew packages, PKG files, plugins, services, app updates, and development environments in the current feature set.
- Monitor apps moved to the Trash through the optional Sentinel cleanup component.
- Export app bundles and file lists, prune unused app translations, and inspect universal-app architectures.

## Where it fits

Pearcleaner suits technically comfortable users who want to see what an uninstall will remove rather than trust a one-click cleaner. It is particularly useful for occasional application cleanup and disk housekeeping.

Full Disk Access and a privileged helper may be needed for some searches and system locations. Review every proposed deletion, keep backups, and note that the project is currently on hold.

## Privacy and requirements

Pearcleaner requires macOS 13 or later and publishes its source for inspection. Finding application leftovers can require Full Disk Access or administrator privileges, depending on their location. Removal decisions remain the user's responsibility: inspect associated files and use the available safeguards before deleting shared support data or material that may belong to another application.

## Pricing

Pearcleaner is free and open source.
